name: kit.colours
description: The brand's colours. A colour that is not a hex is never saved; a hex is kept as #RRGGBB; a blank name is Untitled.
sql: update brandbase.brand_kits k set colours = coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name', coalesce(nullif(btrim(c ->> 'name'), ''), 'Untitled'), 'hex', brandbase.hex_of(c ->> 'hex')) order by n) from jsonb_array_elements(:colours::jsonb) with ordinality t(c, n)), '[]'), version = k.version + 1, updated_at = now() where k.brand_id = :brand returning brandbase.camel(to_jsonb(k)) || jsonb_build_object('updatedAt', brandbase.iso(k.updated_at)) as result
